title: Main Feedwater Pump B Trip on High Bearing Temperature — Post-Maintenance Startup
description: Unit 2 main feedwater pump B (U2-MFP-B) tripped on high bearing temperature 18 minutes after restart during power ascension from refueling outage. Bearing temperature (U2-TE-BRG-2201B) reached 148°F against trip setpoint of 145°F. Trip occurred 18 seconds after pump start. Subsequent investigation found lube oil system venting step (required per MNT-FW-022 Rev. 14) was omitted during post-maintenance work order execution. Lube oil flow indicator (U2-FT-LO-2201B) was in maintenance bypass and not restored prior to startup. Maintenance window compressed 2 hours by outage coordinator direction.

immediate_response.operator_action: Automatic trip. Unit 2 power ascension halted. CR-2026-00741 initiated. Maintenance notified for root cause investigation.
immediate_response.plant_impact: Power ascension halted at 30%. Main feedwater on turbine-driven pump A.
